title: preflight config.json
description: Settings for preflight. Environment variables you set yourself win over these values. Docs: docs/config.md.

$schema.description: Optional: path or URL of this schema, for editor help.

account.description: Default 1Password account (OP_ACCOUNT): the sign-in address for WSL desktop integration (e.g. my-team.1password.com), or the `op account add` shorthand for native op. Env-set entries that name no account use this one.

dirs.description: Directories searched by `proj` (PROJ_DIRS, joined with ':'). A leading ~/ or $HOME/ is expanded.

default_profile.description: AWS profile that `preflight` exports as AWS_PROFILE at session start (AWS_PROFILE_DEFAULT). Empty means none.

main_branch.description: Branch the git helpers treat as the trunk (GIT_MAIN_BRANCH).

username.description: Gitea user name (GITEA_USERNAME), used to store an HTTPS credential when GITEA_TOKEN is loaded.

checks.description: Which sections of the `preflight` health check run.

plugins.description: Opt-in plugins to load (PREFLIGHT_PLUGINS, joined with ':'; ';' on Windows). Each is plugins/<name>/plugin.sh in bash and pwsh/plugins/<name>.ps1 in PowerShell. Nothing loads by default; "owl" is the theme engine, MOTD and Oh My Posh integration.

omp_config.description: Oh My Posh JSON that the owl plugin's owl-theme patches (OWL_OMP_CONFIG; only read when the owl plugin is enabled). Empty turns Oh My Posh integration off; owl-theme still switches splash colors. A leading $PREFLIGHT_STATE_DIR/ or $PREFLIGHT_CONFIG_DIR/ is expanded.
